statement: Let O ⊂ Rn be a bounded convex domain and let f ∈ C4(O) have positive-definite Hessian and solve the affine maximal equation. Suppose −1 ≤ f ≤ 0. If a positive function b0 gives the section control Sf|O (x, b0(r)) ⊂ Br(x) (x ∈ O, r > 0), then f ∈ C∞(O), and for each O′ ⋐ O and integer q ≥ 2 there are positive constants c, Cq such that D2 f ≥ cId, |Dq f| ≤ Cq on O′ . The constants depend only on n, diam O, dist(O′, ∂O), and the specified lower modulus b0, with additional dependence on q for Cq.
